observed: Fresh host contained zero apps before and after source operations.
CLI stored a private project token and explicitly published a private GitHub branch.
Restart preserved credentials and returned the same publication receipt without another commit.
SDK published the next committed snapshot with exact tree identity and executable mode.
Fresh remote fetch found exact binary bytes, the expected tree and exactly two publication commits before the conflict check.
Source duplication defaulted to independent local Git without credentials.
A real remote file addition caused HTTP 409 and remained the branch head.
After importing the remote file, CLI publication acknowledged its exact base and preserved both the file tree and remote history.
Credential ciphertext omitted the token and explicit removal succeeded.
limits: Single GitHub personal-owner/private-repository roundtrip; organization/public creation has not been validated against GitHub.
Lost-response recovery and concurrent push races use real local Git remotes in automated tests.
Automatic fetching/merging of external GitHub changes is not implemented.
